eventDetail.scope: The International Conference on Innovations in High-Speed Communication, Signal Processing, Circuits, and Systems with AI and Applications aims to bring together researchers, industry experts, and innovators to explore emerging trends in advanced communication technologies, intelligent signal processing, and next-generation electronic systems. The conference covers 5G/6G networks, IoT connectivity, optical and wireless communication, adaptive and AI-driven signal processing, VLSI design, embedded systems, and high-performance circuits. Emphasis is placed on real-time processing, automation, smart devices, and application-oriented solutions across healthcare, transportation, robotics, and smart infrastructure. The event fosters collaboration and showcases impactful innovations shaping future intelligent systems.
